description: This line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays categorical data points: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", arranged from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 56 to 66 percent, with grid lines marked at every 2 percentage point interval. The plot contains three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing Precision, a blue line with circular markers representing Recall, and a brown line with circular markers representing F1-score. The Precision line begins at 65.45% for the "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 65.44% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation", showing a slight overall increase with a dip to 60.16% at "w/o Prompt" before recovering to 64.06% at "w/o Attention". The Recall line starts at 65.45% for "Full model (Ours)", drops to 59.64% at "w/o Prompt", rises to a peak of 62.63% at "w/o Augmentation", then declines steadily to 56.82% at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The F1-score line begins at 65.45% for "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 60.16% at "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.22% at "w/o Augmentation", then falls to 59.67% at "w/o Attention" and finally to 57.74% at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
